title: 第11章 天庭第12章 帝道独尊
slug: 提前登陆游戏世界开局联姻女帝
content_zh:
夏辰看到这种异变，瞳孔一凝，这两个月以来，他一直尝试唤醒这方玉玺，但却一直没有一丁点反应。
今日竟然有丝丝缕缕的光芒扩散，夏辰加快脚步，穿过偌大的侯府，进入自己的院子房间中，关上房门。
他感觉自己手心中一片炽热，仿佛有某种东西要从血肉中生长出来。
夏辰能明显感知到自己与玉玺有着彼此联系，仿佛彼此共生，同根同源。
玉玺中有丝丝缕缕的混沌气弥漫，恍惚间夏辰似乎看到道与理在交织，秩序神链激射而出。
神秘的符文在玉玺表面浮现，夏辰看到了有亿万生灵匍匐在地上，仙火焚烧，在广阔亿万里疆域中心，一个高大的祭台用五色混沌石搭筑而成。
一种神秘而古老的祭祀！
夏辰听到了这种仿佛要贯穿诸天的祭祀之音。
“在呼喊我吗？”
夏辰感觉头晕目眩，震耳发聩，浑身的鸡皮疙瘩都起来了。
就在这时，原本虚幻的玉玺，竟然缓缓化为真实，要显化世间，似乎要从某种未知之地降临这方世界。
夏辰情不自禁的朝着悬浮在房间中，散发着丝丝缕缕的紫气的玉玺走去。
下一瞬间，他整个人消失在房间中，被吸进了玉玺中。
而房间外部，平静无比，号称强者无数的镇东侯府没有一个人有丝毫察觉。
……
夏辰快速稳定心神，环顾四周，发现自己来到了一个陌生的世界。
这个世界万物冰封，一片死寂。
只有夏辰所在的周围附近，有丝丝生机，为正常之地。
夏辰发现自己站在一个高大五色祭台上，而祭台上还摆放着一些物品。
比山岳还要庞大的太古凶兽，还滴落着新鲜血液，仿佛刚被猎杀不久。

还有一块散发混沌气混沌玉髓，赤金凤凰神金。
“那是……一枚凤凰卵吗？”
夏辰打量着，发现自己明明第一次见这些物品，但脑海中却突兀的冒出这些物品的信息。
他看到远处悬浮在虚空中，还有浓郁生机，仿佛正在涅盘的一枚卵。
心神俱颤。
他又看到这枚纯血凤凰卵不远处，还有一枚卵仿佛在与这枚凤凰卵交相辉映。
“龙蛋！”
夏辰难以平静，凤凰与真龙，早已绝迹。
纯血凤凰与纯血真龙作为天地间最顶级的神兽，但凡出现踪迹都会掀起腥风血雨。
灵气复苏时代，曾有人得到过几滴凤髓龙血，便快速崛起。
但现在这里有一枚凤凰卵与龙蛋，似乎还有生机，这太惊人了。
“用太古凶兽，稀世真材，甚至纯血龙凤作为贡品，这是在向谁祭祀，苍天吗？不，不是！”
夏辰内心波涛汹涌，究竟是谁能够享受这样的祭品。
他下意识的觉得是在向苍天祭祀，可他环顾四周，立马否决，因为他正屹立在苍天之上，高坐九重天！
这是一座浩瀚宫殿群，以星辰为材料，横跨亿万里，仿佛在镇压诸天。
此时，夏辰仿佛化为了此地之神灵，整个世界仿佛都在他的视野范围内，知晓了此地的一些情况。
content_en:
Xia Chen's pupils froze when he saw this change. For the past two months, he has been trying to wake up Fang Yuxi, but there has been no response at all.
Today, there were wisps of light spreading. Xia Chen quickened his pace, walked through the huge Hou Mansion, entered his courtyard room, and closed the door.
He felt hot in the palm of his hand, as if something was about to grow out of his flesh and blood.
Xia Chen could clearly feel that he and Yuxi were connected to each other, as if they were symbiotic and had the same origin.
There were strands of chaotic energy permeating the jade seal. In a trance, Xia Chen seemed to see the intertwining of Tao and reason, and the divine chain of order shot out.
Mysterious runes appeared on the surface of the jade seal. Xia Chen saw hundreds of millions of creatures prostrate on the ground, burning with fairy fire. In the center of the vast territory of hundreds of millions of miles, a tall altar was built with five-color chaos stones.
A mysterious and ancient sacrifice!
Xia Chen heard this sacrificial sound that seemed to penetrate all the heavens.
"Are you calling me?"
Xia Chen felt dizzy, deafening, and had goosebumps all over his body.
At this moment, the originally illusory jade seal slowly turned into reality. It seemed to be coming to this world from some unknown place.
Xia Chen couldn't help but walk towards the jade seal floating in the room, exuding wisps of purple energy.
The next moment, he disappeared into the room and was sucked into the jade seal.
Outside the room, it was extremely calm, and no one in the Zhendong Hou Mansion, which was known to have countless strong men, was even aware of it.
…
Xia Chen quickly calmed down, looked around, and found that he had arrived in a strange world.
Everything in this world is frozen and dead.
Only the area around Xia Chen was alive, and it was considered a normal place.
Xia Chen found himself standing on a tall five-color altar, and there were some items placed on the altar.
The ancient ferocious beast, which was bigger than the mountains, was still dripping with fresh blood, as if it had just been hunted.
There is also a piece of Chaos Chalcedony that exudes chaos energy, red gold Phoenix divine gold.
"Is that...a phoenix egg?"
Xia Chen looked at it and found that it was the first time for him to see these items, but the information about these items suddenly popped up in his mind.
He saw floating in the void in the distance, and there was a rich vitality, as if an egg was undergoing nirvana.
My heart and mind trembled.
He saw another egg not far away from the pure-blood phoenix egg, which seemed to complement the phoenix egg.
"Dragon egg!"
Xia Chen couldn't calm down, the phoenix and the real dragon had long since disappeared.
The pure-blood phoenix and the pure-blood dragon are the top mythical beasts in the world, and whenever they appear, they will cause a bloody storm.
In the era of spiritual energy recovery, someone once obtained a few drops of phoenix marrow and dragon blood and quickly rose to prominence.
But now there is a phoenix egg and a dragon egg here, which seem to be alive, which is amazing.
"Using ancient ferocious beasts, rare materials, and even pure-blood dragons and phoenixes as tributes, who are you sacrificing to, the heavens? No, no!"
Xia Chen's heart was in turmoil. Who could enjoy such a sacrifice?
He subconsciously felt that he was offering sacrifices to the sky, but he looked around and immediately rejected it, because he was standing on the sky, sitting high in the ninth heaven!
This is a vast palace complex, made of stars, spanning hundreds of millions of miles, as if suppressing the heavens.
At this time, Xia Chen seemed to have turned into a god here, and the whole world seemed to be within his field of vision, knowing some of the conditions here.
